_comment: English for `olla-dft recetas`. `strings` maps every user-facing Spanish string of qekit/modules/recipes.py (recipe data AND fixed report strings) to English; tests/test_v26_recetas.py fails if a recipe string is missing here. Commands, file names and the real program output (`salida`) are deliberately absent: they stay as they are. `keywords` are the plain-English search words per recipe (the English counterpart of `palabras`).

strings.--- Recetas: sesiones completas, de la e: --- Recipes: complete sessions, from the structure to the result ---
strings.Cada una enseña no solo los comandos, si: Each one shows not just the commands, but WHICH FILE every step leaves behind
strings.paso posterior lo lee. Eso es lo que con: and which later step reads it. That is what turns a list of commands into a
strings.flujo de trabajo, y es lo que no está en: workflow, and it is what the help of any single command cannot tell you.
strings.✓ = la receta se ha corrido entera y l: ✓ = the recipe has been run end to end and the output excerpts are the real ones.
strings.Buscar: olla-dft recetas --buscar: Search:       olla-dft recetas --buscar 'does it conduct heat'
strings.Guionizar: olla-dft recetas bandas --: As a script:  olla-dft recetas bandas --script my_session.sh
strings.NOTA: esta receta no se ha corrido enter:
NOTE: this recipe has not been run end to end, so not every step carries an
excerpt of real output. The commands themselves are checked against the
program itself.
strings.(salida real de la corrida, en español): (real output of the run, in Spanish)
there is no recipe called '{clave}'. The ones available:
strings.O búscala con tus palabras: olla-dft re: Or search for it in your own words:  olla-dft recetas --buscar 'does it conduct'
strings.# Cambia el archivo de estructura y las: # Replace the structure file and the paths with your own.
strings.# ESTE PASO CORRE pw.x Y TARDA: #     THIS STEP RUNS pw.x AND TAKES A WHILE
strings.No encuentro ninguna receta para «{texto: I cannot find any recipe for "{texto}".
strings.Lo que has escrito puede ser varias cosa: What you wrote could mean several things. The most likely first:
strings.Te cuento la primera ({clave}); las otra: Here is the first one ({clave}); the others with olla-dft recetas <key>.
strings.Sale COMENTADO y con las rutas de ejempl: It is COMMENTED and uses the example paths: open it, replace the structure with
strings.la tuya y córrelo paso a paso. No lo lan: your own and run it step by step. Do not launch it blindly.
strings.acabo de instalarlo y no sé por dónde em: I just installed it and I don't know where to start
strings.Al final tienes una estructura relajada: At the end you have a relaxed structure with converged parameters, which is the starting point of EVERYTHING else. You do not have any property yet: this is the foundation.
strings.minutos de tu tiempo, ~20 min de máquina: minutes of your time, ~20 min of machine time
strings.Mira la estructura antes de calcular nad: Look at the structure before computing anything: space group, inequivalent sites, distances.
strings.Si el grupo espacial no es el que espera: If the space group is not the one you expected, stop here. A badly centred cell does not raise an error: it gives wrong results for hours.
strings.Elige el pseudopotencial por TAREA y exp: Picks the pseudopotential by TASK and explains every rejection.
strings.Elegir por orden alfabético es cómo acab: Choosing alphabetically is how you end up with PBE Ni and BLYP O in the same calculation.
strings.Barre cutoff y malla k hasta que la ener: Sweeps the cutoff and the k-mesh until the energy stops moving.
strings.No hay un cutoff universal: depende del: There is no universal cutoff: it depends on the pseudopotential. The number that comes out of here is the one you will use in ALL the following calculations, and it has to be the same or the energies cannot be subtracted.
strings.Relaja posiciones y celda con TU funcion: Relaxes positions and cell with YOUR functional.
strings.Una estructura de una base de datos NO e: A structure from a database is NOT at the minimum of your functional. That residual stress contaminates the elastic constants, the phonons and everything else.
strings.saber si es metal o semiconductor: find out whether it is a metal or a semiconductor
strings.ver si es estable y cuánto cuesta deform: see whether it is stable and how hard it is to deform
strings.si no sabes qué quieres, pregúntaselo al: if you don't know what you want, ask the wizard
strings.Estructura de bandas, DOS y gap: Band structure, DOS and band gap
strings.¿es metal o semiconductor? ¿cuánto vale: is it a metal or a semiconductor? what is its band gap?
strings.Al final tienes la figura de bandas + DO: At the end you have the bands + DOS figure ready for a paper and the gap with its character (direct or indirect). WATCH OUT: the LDA/PBE gap is 30-50 % smaller than the experimental one. That is NOT a failure of the calculation.
strings.~15 min de máquina en un sistema pequeño: ~15 min of machine time on a small system
strings.Escribe de una vez los tres inputs encad: Writes the three chained inputs at once: scf, nscf and bands, with the high-symmetry path already in place.
strings.la estructura relajada y el cutoff: the relaxed structure and the cutoff
strings.El camino de alta simetría se calcula so: The high-symmetry path is computed on the standard primitive cell. If your cell is a different one, the labels Γ, X, L do not point where they say; `olla-dft prim` standardises it.
Runs the three steps in order.
Reads the bands, detects the gap and plots.
strings.el XML del cálculo de bandas: the XML of the bands calculation
strings.Un gap de 0 eV con ocupaciones fijas no: A gap of 0 eV with fixed occupations does not mean «metal»: it means the calculation was not valid. Metals need smearing.
strings.Densidad de estados y proyección por orb: Density of states and projection per orbital.
strings.Integrar la DOS hasta E_F tiene que devo: Integrating the DOS up to E_F has to give back the number of valence electrons. If it doesn't, the nscf mesh is too coarse.
strings.Bandas y DOS en una sola figura, con el: Bands and DOS in a single figure, sharing the energy axis. This is what the command exists for: there is no flag to switch on.
strings.un modelo pequeño que interpole las band: a small model that interpolates the bands for free
strings.Estabilidad, dureza y lo que se deduce d: Stability, hardness and what follows from them
strings.¿es estable? ¿qué tan duro es? ¿a qué te: is it stable? how hard is it? what Debye temperature does it correspond to?
strings.Al final tienes las constantes elásticas: At the end you have the elastic constants with the Born criterion, the moduli, the sound velocities, the Debye temperature and an estimate of the thermal conductivity — all from the same calculation.
strings.Curva energía-volumen y su ajuste: parám: Energy-volume curve and its fit: equilibrium lattice parameter and bulk modulus.
strings.Hacen falta al menos 5 puntos y a AMBOS: You need at least 5 points, on BOTH sides of the minimum. A fit with all the points on one side gives a B0 that looks reasonable and is wrong.
strings.Las 6×6 constantes elásticas por deforma: The 6×6 elastic constants by finite strains.
The cell has to be relaxed BEFOREHAND. A residual stress goes straight into the Cij.
strings.Post-proceso puro: velocidades del sonid: Pure post-processing: sound velocities, Debye, Grüneisen and Slack. Nothing new is run.
strings.La Debye elástica y la que sale de la DO: The elastic Debye temperature and the one from the phonon DOS are NOT the same definition. A 20 % difference is normal; agreement to 1 % would be suspicious.
strings.Compara el B0 de la EOS con el que sale: Compares the B0 from the EOS with the one from the trace of the Cij: two independent routes to the same quantity.
strings.Este comando no sirve de nada hasta que: This command is useless until TWO modules have left results. That is the whole idea: a single number cannot be validated.
strings.fonones, que dan la otra Debye: phonons, which give the other Debye temperature
strings.conductividad térmica de verdad, no la d: the real thermal conductivity, not Slack's estimate
strings.¿es dinámicamente estable? ¿cuánto vale: is it dynamically stable? what is its specific heat? where do its Raman peaks appear?
strings.Al final tienes la dispersión de fonones: At the end you have the phonon dispersion, the DOS, C_v(T), the zero-point energy and, if you ask for them, the Raman intensities with their depolarisation ratio.
strings.horas: es el cálculo más caro de esta li: hours: this is the most expensive calculation in this list
strings.Escribe la cadena entera: scf muy conver: Writes the whole chain: tightly converged scf → ph.x → q2r → matdyn (dispersion and DOS).
strings.El scf de aquí necesita conv_thr mucho m: The scf here needs a much tighter conv_thr than a normal one. With 1e-6 the phonons come out with imaginary frequencies that are NOT an instability: they are noise.
strings.Los cinco pasos en orden. Es reanudable:: The five steps in order. It is resumable: if it gets cut off, launch it again and it picks up where it was.
strings.Frecuencias imaginarias en Γ que no sean: Imaginary frequencies at Γ other than the three acoustic ones = the structure is not relaxed, or the q-mesh is too small. It is almost never physics.
strings.La termodinámica ya la dejó el paso ante: The previous step already left the thermodynamics in FONONES_TERMO.dat. What is missing is checking it: here C_v at high temperature is cross-checked against Dulong-Petit and the integral of the DOS against 3N.
strings.A alta temperatura C_v tiene que tender: At high temperature C_v has to tend to 3N·k_B. If it falls short, the DOS is badly normalised or part of the spectrum is missing; if it overshoots, there are extra modes.
strings.expansión térmica: repite los fonones a: thermal expansion: repeat the phonons at several volumes
strings.conductividad térmica de red, que necesi: lattice thermal conductivity, which needs the third order
strings.Un termoeléctrico completo: las tres pie: A complete thermoelectric: the three pieces of ZT
strings.¿sirve como termoeléctrico? ¿cuánto vale: is it any good as a thermoelectric? what is its ZT?
strings.ZT = S²σT/(κ_e + κ_L). Esta receta calcu: ZT = S²σT/(κ_e + κ_L). This recipe computes the FOUR quantities by different routes and puts them together. It is the one that best shows how the modules relate to each other: none of them gives ZT on its own.
strings.días si lo haces todo con DFT; horas si: days if you do everything with DFT; hours if you use the machine-learned potential to explore first
strings.El transporte necesita una malla de k MU: Transport needs a MUCH denser k-mesh than a band structure: derivatives of the occupation are integrated, not energies.
strings.Con una malla de bandas normal el Seebec: With a normal bands mesh the Seebeck coefficient comes out with tens of µV/K of noise. If S changes when you densify, it was not converged.
strings.σ/τ, Seebeck y κ_e/τ en la aproximación: σ/τ, Seebeck and κ_e/τ in the constant relaxation time approximation.
strings.S y el número de Lorenz NO dependen de τ: S and the Lorenz number do NOT depend on τ; σ and κ_e do. Publishing σ from a CRTA without saying which τ you used is publishing a number without units.
strings.Acoplamiento electrón-fonón: de aquí sal: Electron-phonon coupling: this is where the real τ comes from, the one the previous step is missing.
strings.Son TRES pasos y el segundo es el que se: There are THREE steps and the second is the one people forget: without the nscf with la2F=.true. there is no a2Fsave file and ph.x dies without saying why.
strings.Primero explora barato: κ_L con un poten: Explore cheaply first: κ_L with a machine-learned potential to choose the supercell size.
strings.El valor absoluto de un potencial aprend: The absolute value from a machine-learned potential can be off by a factor of 2-3. The shape of κ(T) and the convergence with the supercell do come out right, and that is what it is for.
strings.Y ahora el de verdad: las mismas configu: And now the real one: the same configurations with pw.x.
strings.el tamaño de supercelda que eligió ④: the supercell size chosen in ④
strings.κ tiene que converger en el tamaño de la: κ has to converge in the supercell size AND in the q-mesh AT THE SAME TIME.
strings.Cruza la κ del tercer orden contra la es: Cross-checks the third-order κ against the Slack estimate that came from the elastic constants. Two independent routes.
strings.Con la κ del potencial aprendido este cr: With the κ from the machine-learned potential this cross-check FAILS (87 % deviation). That is not a failure of the cross-check: it is the cross-check doing its job.
strings.si κ_L sale alta, mira el recorrido libr: if κ_L comes out high, look at the mean free path: it tells you whether nanostructuring helps
strings.De cristal a superficie, y de superficie: From crystal to surface, and from surface to catalyst
strings.quiero cortar una cara, saber cuánto cue: I want to cut a facet, know how much it costs to make, what its work function is and whether something adsorbs on it
strings.Al final tienes γ por el ajuste de Fiore: At the end you have γ from the Fiorentini–Methfessel fit, the work function without fitting any plateau, the inequivalent adsorption sites with their energy, and the free-energy diagram of the reaction.
strings.Corta la cara (111) sobre la celda conve: Cuts the (111) facet on the conventional cell, with vacuum, warning if the surface is polar.
strings.Una superficie polar no converge a nada: A polar surface does not converge to anything useful without compensating the dipole. The command warns you; heeding it is up to you.
strings.Energía de superficie por el ajuste line: Surface energy from the Fiorentini–Methfessel linear fit over several thicknesses, not by subtracting an imported bulk energy.
strings.γ calculada con una E_bulto de otro cálc: γ computed with an E_bulk from another calculation does NOT converge as the slab gets thicker: it drifts linearly. That is why several thicknesses are needed.
strings.Función trabajo con la condición de cont: Work function with the ESM boundary condition: the vacuum level is zero by construction, so Φ = −E_F without fitting any plateau.
ESM measures z from the CENTRE of the cell. Olla-DFT centres the slab on its own; if you put it at c/2 by hand, it lands on the boundary and you get hundreds of Ry of error with no message.
strings.Encuentra los sitios no equivalentes (to: Finds the inequivalent sites (top, bridge, hollow) and computes the adsorption energy at each one.
strings.Los sitios se buscan por huella de vecin: Sites are found by neighbour fingerprint, not by radius: with a radius you got three hollows where there are only two.
strings.Del ΔE de adsorción al diagrama de energ: From the adsorption ΔE to the free-energy diagram: limiting potential and overpotential.
strings.la energía de adsorción del mejor sitio: the adsorption energy of the best site
strings.Sin las correcciones térmicas (ZPE − TΔS: Without the thermal corrections (ZPE − TΔS) the ΔG is off by tenths of an eV, which is exactly the size of the differences under discussion.
strings.superficie cargada, a un potencial dado: charged surface, at a given potential
strings.¿cuánto cuesta hacer una vacante? ¿en qu: how much does it cost to make a vacancy? which charge state is it in, depending on where the Fermi level lies?
strings.Al final tienes E_f(E_F) para cada estad: At the end you have E_f(E_F) for each charge state, the envelope and the transition levels ε(q/q'), which is what gets compared with a DLTS measurement.
strings.Construye la supercelda con el defecto e: Builds the supercell with the defect in each charge state, plus the perfect reference supercell.
strings.Un número impar de electrones con ocupac: An odd number of electrons with fixed occupations makes pw.x abort with «the system is metallic». Olla-DFT sets nspin=2 and tot_magnetization in ALL charge states, not just the odd one, so that they are comparable with each other.
strings.Energías de formación con la corrección: Formation energies with the Madelung image correction, and the transition levels.
strings.las energías de cada estado de carga: the energies of each charge state
strings.El potencial químico μ NO es opcional: E: The chemical potential μ is NOT optional: E_f depends on it linearly. An E_f without saying which μ it was computed with means nothing.
strings.Comprueba que la supercelda del defecto: Checks that the defect supercell and the perfect one are comparable before subtracting them.
strings.si el defecto tiene un nivel dentro del: if the defect has a level inside the gap, look at its states
strings.De DFT a un modelo pequeño que interpola: From DFT to a small model that interpolates for free
strings.quiero la banda en cualquier punto k sin: I want the band at any k-point without running DFT again, and the polarization while I'm at it
strings.Al final tienes H(R): una matriz pequeña: At the end you have H(R): a small matrix from which the energy at ANY k comes out in microseconds. With it you get fine Fermi surfaces, transport on otherwise impossible meshes and electric polarization.
strings.~10 min de máquina para un sistema peque: ~10 min of machine time for a small system
strings.Escribe los cuatro pasos: scf, nscf de m: Writes the four steps: scf, FULL-mesh nscf, the .nnkp (which wannier90 normally writes) and pw2wannier90.
strings.El nscf va con nosym y noinv a la fuerza: The nscf must use nosym and noinv: ALL the mesh points are needed, not the irreducible wedge. wannier90 does not need to be installed.
strings.Los cuatro pasos en orden, incluido el c: The four steps in order, including the DFT bands calculation it will be compared against.
strings.Proyección, minimización de la dispersió: Projection, spread minimisation, H(R) and interpolation — and the comparison against the DFT bands at points that were NOT in the mesh.
strings.Que reproduzca la malla de partida es TR: Reproducing the starting mesh is TRIVIAL: it is interpolation. The only thing that tells you whether the model is any good is comparing it at points that were not there, and for that you need the 4_bands step.
strings.La misma fase de Berry que hay detrás de: The same Berry phase behind the Wannier centres, now via the lberry route: this is where the Born effective charge comes from.
strings.Un valor de P suelto no significa nada:: A lone value of P means nothing: it is defined modulo the quantum. Only the DIFFERENCE along a path is physical.
strings.Cruza la fase electrónica de lberry cont: Cross-checks the electronic phase from lberry against the one given by the Wannier centres. Two routines that do not share a single line of code.
strings.DOS en una malla de 24³ sin tocar pw.x: DOS on a 24³ mesh without touching pw.x
strings.bandas entrelazadas (conducción, metales: entangled bands (conduction, metals): you need energy windows
strings.Cómo saber que lo que calculaste está bi: How to know that what you computed is right
strings.ya tengo resultados: ¿cómo sé que no son: I already have results: how do I know they are not garbage?
strings.Tres comprobaciones distintas y compleme: Three different and complementary checks: that the code does the arithmetic right, that your calculations converged and are comparable with each other, and that two independent routes give the same thing.
strings.Contrasta el propio código contra valore: Checks the code itself against known values from the literature, each with its source. It needs neither Quantum ESPRESSO nor your data.
strings.Si esto falla, el problema no está en tu: If this fails, the problem is not in your calculation: it is in the installation.
strings.Mira la traza de convergencia y distingu: Looks at the convergence trace and tells charge sloshing apart from slow convergence, which call for OPPOSITE remedies.
strings.Terminar y converger no son lo mismo. Un: Finishing and converging are not the same thing. An scf that runs out of electron_maxstep writes «JOB DONE» just like a good one.
strings.Comprueba que dos cálculos son comparabl: Checks that two calculations are comparable before subtracting their energies: functional, pseudopotentials, cutoffs, occupations.
strings.Restar energías incomparables es el erro: Subtracting incomparable energies is the most expensive mistake in DFT, and the only one that gives no warning at all.
strings.La misma cantidad por dos caminos indepe: The same quantity by two independent routes. It needs TWO modules to have results already.
strings.todo lo que hayan dejado los demás módul: everything the other modules have left behind
strings.Un cruce que falla NO dice cuál de los d: A failing cross-check does NOT say which of the two routes is wrong: it says one of them is.
strings.Junta todo lo calculado en una ficha con: Gathers everything computed into a datasheet with its methodology and provenance, ready to paste into the paper.
strings.si algo falló, quedó registrado con su t: if something failed, it was logged with its traceback and versions
